# GuitarSet attribution

GuitarSet v1.1.0, published 2019-08-20.

Creators: Qingyang Xi, Rachel M. Bittner, Johan Pauwels, Xuzhou Ye, Juan P. Bello.

Official data record: https://zenodo.org/records/3371780

DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.3371780

Audio and annotations license: **Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)**, confirmed from the official record API on 2026-10-11. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

Data remain the work of the original creators. This project selects diagnostic samples and converts JAMS note annotations to CSV. Such conversion and any normalization, transcription, or human correction must be identified as this project's processing, not the creators' original annotation.

Citation: Q. Xi, R. Bittner, J. Pauwels, X. Ye and J. P. Bello, “GuitarSet: A Dataset for Guitar Transcription,” Proceedings of the 19th International Society for Music Information Retrieval Conference (ISMIR), Paris, 2018.

The official GuitarSet code repository uses MIT; that code license must not be substituted for the dataset's CC BY 4.0 license.
